review_method: Two model reviewers each read one disjoint half of the fixed sample; decisions are not human, blind cross-review, factual verification or license clearance.
observed_problems: Language-conversion markup remained in one sampled paragraph.
Some passages depend on omitted context or contain ambiguous translations.
Travel costs, routes, safety and geographic claims may be stale or unverified.
The sample has 40 paragraphs from 38 pages; decisions do not establish page-level or corpus-level quality.
